# Aftab Ahmed — AI Automation & Marketing

> Aftab Ahmed is a designer turned systems builder (8+ years in design and marketing, 1,500+ projects) who helps US, UK and European small businesses grow with AI automation, AI chatbots, Google Ads, Facebook & Instagram ads and lead generation systems with instant follow-up. Based in Pakistan, working remotely.

## About
- [About Aftab Ahmed](https://iamaftabahmed.com/about/): background, approach and who he works with

## Services
- [AI Automation & AI Chatbots](https://iamaftabahmed.com/services/ai-automation/): assistants that answer, qualify and book leads 24/7, plus admin automation
- [Google Ads Management](https://iamaftabahmed.com/services/google-ads/): high-intent search campaigns, landing pages and conversion tracking
- [Facebook & Instagram Ads](https://iamaftabahmed.com/services/facebook-ads/): offers, creative, lead forms and Meta tracking
- [Lead Generation](https://iamaftabahmed.com/services/lead-generation/): ads, landing pages, CRM and speed-to-lead follow-up

- [Dental & Medical Practices](https://iamaftabahmed.com/industries/dental/): AI receptionist, missed-call text back, reminders and local ads for practices
- [Real Estate & Property](https://iamaftabahmed.com/industries/real-estate/): instant lead replies, qualification, showing booking and nurture for agents
- [Accounting & CPA Firms](https://iamaftabahmed.com/industries/accounting/): enquiry handling, automated onboarding and document reminders for firms

- [Med Spas & Aesthetics](https://iamaftabahmed.com/industries/med-spa/): offer-led Meta ads, instant lead replies, booking and rebooking reminders
- [Law Firms](https://iamaftabahmed.com/industries/law/): 24/7 intake, case screening, consultation booking and practice-area ads
